integrity: The classical hook-length volume identity and Stanley transfer map are explicitly treated as background. The new claim is the full uniform-volume beta factorization, every mixed moment, and the strict three-way pairwise covariance law. No independence or external audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite rooted forests with each nonminimal vertex covering exactly one parent; no analogous independence or covariance-sign claim is made for arbitrary posets. Negative search results are not novelty proofs and exact priority against unlocated probabilistic reformulations remains open.
title: Exact beta moment factorization and covariance signs for rooted-forest chain polytopes
